short: Spanish: a bang, report, or crash.
note: Spanish estampido means a loud bang or report, such as a gunshot, explosion, or thunderclap.

short: The extensive cave system in Kentucky.
note: The immense limestone cave system in Kentucky protected by Mammoth Cave National Park, the world’s longest known cave system.

short: A biblical name associated with child sacrifice.
note: Moloch, also spelled Molech, a name associated in the Hebrew Bible with forbidden child sacrifice; Leviticus 18:21 prohibits giving children to Molech.
